proceedings.deciding_body: Disciplinary Chamber of the QDC of Zakarpattya
proceedings.outcome: the applicant’s licence to practise as an advocate was suspended for six months
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 17 April 2013, in the applicant’s absence, the Disciplinary Chamber of the QDC of Zakarpattya suspended the applicant’s licence to practise as an advocate for six months

proceedings.outcome: the decision of 17 April 2013 was upheld
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 16 May the QDC of Zakarpattya upheld the decision of 17 April 2013.

proceedings.outcome: the draft decision to annul the previous decisions was rejected and the suspension remained valid
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 22 July 2016 the draft decision was put to vote at a HQDCB meeting... the draft decision was rejected and the decisions suspending the applicant’s licence remained valid.

proceedings.outcome: found that all the decisions issued by the self-government bodies of the Bar against the applicant had been lawful
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 8 April 2021 the Kyiv District Administrative Court found that all the decisions issued by the self-government bodies of the Bar against the applicant had been lawful.

proceedings.outcome: decided not to examine the applicant’s appeal
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 22 December 2016 the Podilskyy District Court decided not to examine the applicant’s appeal.
On 6 March 2017 the Kyiv Administrative Court of Appeal quashed the decision of 22 December 2016.
The applicant’s appeals were rejected (final decision of the Supreme Court of 9 December 2021).
